blocks.text: Alkanes saturated hydrocarbons hain jin ka general formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ hai. Methane (CH₄) is family ka sab se saada member hai. Alkanes ki homologous series (aisi series jis ka har agla member CH₂ zyada rakhta hai) condensed structural formulae aur molecular formulae ke saath Table 11.1 mein hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Butane lighters mein fuel ke taur par istemal hoti hai. Isobutane shaving gel jaisi cheezon mein propellant (cheez ko bahar dhakelne wali gas) ke taur par istemal hoti hai.

blocks.caption: Table 11.1 Alkanes ke condensed structural formulae aur molecular formulae

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Table 11.1 mein heptane ka formula C₇H₁₀ aur condensed structure CH₃ CH₂ CH₃ CH₂ CH₂ CH₂ CH₃ chhapa hai. CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ mein n = 7 rakhein to C₇H₁₆ aata hai, aur chain mein dono CH₃ ends (siron) ke darmiyan paanch CH₂ groups hote hain. ‘Butana’ bhi chhapai ki ghalti hai, sahi naam butane hai. Oopar table sahi values ke saath hai.

Alkane se aik hydrogen atom hata dein to jo bachta hai use alkyl group kehte hain. Alkyl groups ka naam alkane ke naam ke aakhir se –ane hata kar –yl laga kar rakha jata hai. Kuch misalein Table 11.2 aur Table 11.3 mein hain.

blocks.caption: Table 11.2 Alkyl groups, un ke naam aur abbreviations (mukhtasar naam)

blocks.text: Jin alkanes mein do se zyada carbon atoms hon, un se aik se zyada alkyl groups ban sakte hain, kyunke hydrogen different (alag alag) carbons se hataya ja sakta hai.

blocks.caption: Table 11.3 Alkyl groups: seedhi chain aur branched, un ke naam

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Table 11.3 mein butane ‘H₃CH₀CH₂CH₃’ chhapa hai; sahi H₃CCH₂CH₂CH₃ hai. tert-Butyl group ka IUPAC naam ‘1,1-Dimethylpropyl’ chhapa hai; sahi 1,1-dimethylethyl hai, kyunke jure hue carbon se sab se lambi chain sirf do carbon ki hai. ‘iso-Propul’ aur ‘Iso-Butyle’ ke sahi spelling isopropyl aur isobutyl hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Table mein (–) woh jagah dikhata hai jahan se hydrogen hataya gaya; isi carbon se alkyl group doosre atom se judta hai. Propyl mein yeh jagah end (sire) wala carbon hai aur isopropyl mein darmiyan wala.

items: Alkanes CₙH₂ₙ₊₂, saturated, methane se decane tak (Table 11.1); har agla member CH₂ zyada.
Alkyl group = alkane se aik H kam, –ane ki jagah –yl: methyl (Me–), ethyl (Et–), n- aur isopropyl, n-, sec-, iso- aur tert-butyl.
